nom: Clinique 7 Day Face Scrub Cream Rinse-Off Formula

avis.texte: First, this product was received as a free gift with purchase. I am unsure how old the stock us. This tube has an unpleasant adhesive scent to it. I have a sensitive nose to be honest and others may not notice it. It is awful however. Second is that this scrub leaves a film after washing. This is a big no for a facial product. I wish it wasn't such a large sample as I won't use it. Maybe on my feet? I am post menopausal and have used numerous brands as part of my facial routine. I have acne prone sensitive skin.
This is the perfect scrub to use daily. Gets the job done but is not too abrasive by any means. I use in the shower each day and it makes my skin feel very clear and clean.

Though I didn't purchase this product at Ulta, I received it as a gift from a friend last year. This was one of the products in her Clinique make-up glam bag she gave me. This 7 days scrub is essential to add and use to your skincare routine in the morning and also at night. It also doesn't irritate your skin or have an awful scent. Your skin would feel smooth on your face and offer a healthy shiny glow. It works great to scrub it off with a cotton pad to wipe away dry skin, make-up, oils, and dirt from your face. Get ready to get your shine on.

I was dubious that a facewash could help reduce redness, but this really works. The accompanying face lotion is just too pricey for me, but even without it the facewash makes a difference. Back for more...

I love the 7 day scrub cream - it is exactly what it says it is. It is gentle enough to use on a daily basis, but has enough grit to really give that clean finish and no residue. It is one of my favorite cleansers for sure and I would highly recommend to anyone who likes that extra clean feeling when you wash your face (and who doesn't?)!

I've been using the 7 Day Scrub Cream Rinse-Off Formula consistently, and it has completely upgraded my skincare routine. The texture is creamy with just enough grit to actually feel like it's doing something, but not so harsh that it leaves my skin red or irritated. What I love most is how smooth my skin feels immediately after using it. Makeup goes on better. Skincare absorbs better. My face just feels polished without feeling stripped. It's gentle enough to use daily, but effective enough to see and feel a difference after one use. I also appreciate that it doesn't have a strong fragrance and doesn't leave behind a weird film. If you want something that exfoliates without attacking your face like sandpaper, this is it.
I ordered for myself and my mom tried it she is 60+. she loved it so much and she ordered for Herself too.
Have been using this off and on for several years. I really like how it feels on my skin. Makes my skin feel softer after use.

avis.titre: A Daily Scrub for Every Day
avis.texte: I've used many facial care products over the last 50yrs, in an attempt to find what works best to: Cleanse & Exfoliate; Leave my Skin Smooth, Hydrated, & Prepped for Serums, Moisturizers, Sunscreens etc…. For 8mo I've used this scrub & I continue to be quite pleased w/my facial skin's overall daily health & appearance. Clinique facial care products have not disappointed me. l really like this scrub, & am very happy w/their Moisture Surge line of products! The most important step, which I forget sometimes, is to make certain I drink enough Water every day. When I keep up my water intake, my skin radiates, even if I am still sporting a few fine lines:)
This is simply the best exfoliator. I use once a week and have sensitive skin and it exfoliates well.
I love that you can use this product to exfoliate your face weekly.

I have tried numerous times to use this product and it does a very poor job of cleaning my face and removing residual makeup, even when I use a make up removing cloth before hand. The make up I use is the Even Better clinical, and the foaming cleanser in the pink tube has not problem removing it. Also, the exfoliating particles tend to get in my eyes when I rinse the product off, even though I have them closed.
I love this face wash it takes my make up right off and has helped with the little bumps I get on my face.

Best exfoliater I've ever used, doesn't have an over powering fragrance either. I use a massaging motion when I apply this and my skin comes out looking 10 times smoother and more radiant. I would definitely recommend

I have tried numerous products for the dry skin on my face, and nothing works like this product. This is the only product I have used that works for my dry skin! A little goes a long way, which I appreciate. This has to be one of my favorite skincare products, and I am picky!
I've taken it on vacation with me and it does clean my skin properly after a long day.
I received this product as a gift with purchase and boy, do I love it! It washed away whatever was dulling my skin. My face seemed brighter, clearer!
so great to use after being outside all day in the heat. really feels like it takes off all the dirt. leaves my skin feeling so smooth after. 100% recommend
Cleanses the skin perfectly. I use it every other day. The skin has become much better looking, the rashes have gone away
I have loved this product for so many years. It's not harsh on the skin and it perfectly sloughs off the top, rough, dead layers revealing soft beautiful skin. It's not harsh it's just perfect.
This is the only exfoliator I've ever used that doesn't cause irritation and breakouts. My skin GLOWS!
My new favorite cleanser. Although it has small beads to help exfoliate the skin, it's super gentle and I use it everyday.

I tried this based on a recommendation from a Clinique specialist in Ulta. I have seasonal combination skin that's very sensitive and prone to acne, and she promised this would be gentle but also help with my issues. She was right and I'm very happy.

I received a sample size for free and I can't speak to how well it works because I couldn't get beyond the smell. It smells like a mixture of tequila and plastic. I used this once and immediately threw it away. Super disappointing because I love Clinique products.

avis.titre: Solves foundation issues in cold climes
avis.texte: I had been to many makeup advisors asking what I could do about my foundation looking like it had white dots beneath it and until I went to clinique no suggestions solved it. The clinique advisor told me my skin was dry and that was the cause and using this daily would solve it. I'm in New England, over 50, thought Clinique was for young women. This is a lifesaver in the winter keeping skin exfoliated without damage!
I have very reactive sensitive skin. This us very coarse and harsh on skin. Feels like sandpaper. Made my skin red, irritated and broke me out after one use.
I have used this product for probably 20 years. Leaves my skin clean but smooth and moisturized. I prefer this over the thinner, oiler products.

avis.titre: Product is GREAT, but very pricey
avis.texte: Product is GREAT, but very pricey. It makes your face feel exfoliated with a mild moisturizer even after rinsing.

avis.titre: Absolutely love this product 10 out of 10 ￼
avis.texte: This product is perfect to remove flakes and purities from your face, leaving a clean, soft feeling I would recommend using it one day yes one day no and don't scrub too hard on your skin. You can irritate yourskin for those with very sensitive skin

I am glad that i tried this product. Being 70 with dry sensitive skin i must be careful with what i put my face. The 7 day scrub did not irritate my skin! My face looks healthier, improving pores, all in all my skin looks more youthful! Thankful to have this product.

avis.titre: Skin is soft but the smell is terrible
avis.texte: My skin feels so clean-and smooth. The smell though is the worst. Like burnt plastic. I dont trust the formula woth such a terrible smell so i decided to stop using.

avis.titre: Finally, something my skin doesn't hate!
avis.texte: I got this 2 weeks ago from Ulta on the recommendation of an older employee who actually took the time to ask about my skin. I have combo (oily T-area / stupid dry cheeks and brows, like flakey tight) and ultra sensitive skin. She recommended to add this to my routine 2-3 times a week to help get rid of those pesty flakes around my oily nose and help my dry skin take in my moisturizing products better...and wow. My skin feels so so soft! I haven't found an exfoliator that hasn't irritated or overdried my skin until now-- this is insane to be honest. The skin around my nose is actually smooth....I feel like maybe I can actually wear makeup again without the flaking! 2 weeks in, I'm super happy

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel incredibly soft
avis.texte: I have used Clinique's exfoliating scrub on and off for many years. While I sometimes like to try other brands, the Clinique scrub is the only one that makes me feel like I have brand new, incredibly soft skin. I have dry skin so I use the scrub two times a week. In the wintertime, sometimes only once a week. This product doesn't disappoint!

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel incredibly soft
avis.texte: I have used Clinique's exfoliating scrub on and off for many years. While I sometimes like to try other brands, the Clinique scrub is the only one that makes me feel like I have brand new, incredibly soft skin. I have dry skin so I use the scrub two times a week. In the wintertime, sometimes only once a week. This product doesn't disappoint!
I've used this product for over 10 years quality not the same and price has gone through the roof. Not happy about these things.
This face scrub felt really rough on my skin! It hurt to rub in. I would not recommend this if you have sensitive skin like me.

avis.titre: I would most definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: As I had written previously, I have been a Clinique products user for well over 40 years. I love all of them!

avis.titre: I would buy this produce again.
avis.texte: Clinique products is always my first choice of brands of cosmetics. This scrub is gentle but very effective.

When I was in my twenties through my early fourties' I disliked this scrub because I always felt it was on the oily side. My favorite product in this category was the exfoliating scrub with a bit more abrasive texture and minty tingle. As I approach my late fourties' my oily, acne prone skin has since developed a sensitivity to most products. I ran out of my exfoliating scrub and avoided using scrubs thinking it would help with my skin issues. On a whim I tried the seven day scrub that was part of a gift with purchase. I was blown away by the results. The seven day scrub gives me the exfoliation that my skin craves with just a touch of moisture to keep the sensitivity at bay. This scrub compliments the three step program for "number 4" oily acne prone skin beautifully. The scrub is gentle enough to use daily with no issues. My skin glows and the number of breakouts have diminished and my skin texture is extremely smooth. I regret not trying this skincare combo sooner. Sometimes a slow and steady approach to skincare wins the race.

avis.titre: I would buy this product always.
avis.texte: Been using this for many years, it is the best for getting rid of dead skin and flaking. I have had oily skin for most of my life and still got flaking. Cannot go without this product since I need to use it daily.
I use this product almost daily and find that I can not go without it. It removes the dead skin cells to make my skin brighter.

I didn't expect to like it so much! I thought it could be a bit harsh on my sensitive skin but it's not at all. It leaves my skin feeling so soft! I use it 3 times a week and I'm super happy I now have a mini version as well to take when I travel.

I will never go without this scrub! It has made my skin feel soft and beautiful! I have oily combination skin and I swear between this and the Clinique face wash I have seen a reduction in oil on my face! It's gentle enough I can use everyday! Helps remove any make up residue of dried on sweat from the gym! My acne is also much more controlled from starting this product! LOVE IT!!
This has taken care of flaking on my face and my makeup goes on so much better. Love it.
Initially I didn't like the scrub cream much and I really wished the beads were bigger but over a period of a few days, I really started enjoying how soft it left my skin.

I get it, you like to change and "improve", but how about just add a new product and stop messing with customer favorites? Taking the menthol out of the other face scrub, and now less exfoliants in this formula just makes it feel pointless. And you can also stop with the replies that someone will follow up with the customer. That never happens. I am going to go to a comparable brand, I am done with this.
This scrub is a great addition to my basic face care routine. used twice a week. It's enough. Consumption is very economical. does not dry or irritate the skin
Great product and gentle enough for everyday. It doesn't leave me feeling dry or stripped / too shiny.
I do not know if Clinique changed the formula, but my skin feels greasy after I use it.
It's a new product for me. I like it so much. Doesn't dry out skin
I've used 7 Day Scrub for 40 years and it is one essential product to my skincare regimen. It helps refresh my skin by removing dry skin cells. I also feel it helps add a glow to my skin.

avis.titre: Love this product. Will buy again
avis.texte: A great gental skin polisher. I like that it doesn't feel like sandpaper on my face. If I do by chance want it extra course I don't use as much water.

avis.titre: Love the texture of this scrub!
avis.texte: If you are looking for a cream-based exfoliator, this is the one! I use it two to three times a week to remove dead skin cells and it does the job without causing redness or irritation. It is gentle enough to use daily which is a plus. You only need a little bit of product per use, a little goes a long way. My face feels fresh every time I use it.

avis.titre: also burned and broke my face out
avis.texte: Also want to add that this burned my face and caused irritation breakouts where it was red and raw from the scrub.. my la girl mint color corrector couldn't even stick to a raw red patch when I tried to cover it up even with primer. After I removed my makeup and washed my face last night I couldn't use my serums in fear of making it worse.

I used this when it was in a free mini gift set. Unfortunately it is crap. After I used it and rinsed off thoroughly even with washing my face again it still flaked off on my lower cheeks. also has coconut oil in it, not for acne prone.

this is a scrub that can be used daily and won't dry out your skin even with sensitive or dry skin. works for all skin types. very creamy. can be used with a rotating brush also. it's one of the best products I've ever used. been in my skin care routine for about 10 years.
The cream feels amazing but the little exfoliates are very rough on sensitive skin. It didn't help remove my dry flakes either.
I have been using this product 1-3 times a week for over 30 years. I follow with the 2 in 1 toner. People are surprised at my true age all the time.

avis.titre: I wanted to like it, but...
avis.texte: I have incredibly dry, sensitive skin with flushing/rosacea and frequent acne. I got a sample size of this scrub and used it for a week, and my skin looked and felt improved. So I got the full size one, thinking I'd finally found something my skin didn't hate. How wrong I was! First use of the full size bottle, and my face broke out all over. Tried it again, more breakouts. Used it for a week, worse skin than ever before. Stopped for a week or so to give my skin a break, used the sample size again with no issues. Tried the big size yet again, skin got awful again. All I can figure is that maybe somehow the formula was different in the small size vs the large size? Whatever the case, I wasted a chunk of money and it's too late now to return it.

This is my favorite face scrub! I am a loyal Clinique girl and this scrub is THE BEST! It always leaves my face super smooth and doesn't irritate it, I use it twice a day. It can dry your face in the winter months so I use a moisturizer. 10/10!
It's a great exfoliating scrub. It's very gentle not harsh at all. When you're finished using it will leave your face feeling soft not that dry out feeling.

I've been hooked on this scrub ever since my mom put a travel size in my stocking at Christmas time. I used up that travel bottle and have been buying the full sizes ever since. It makes my skin feel clean and fresh, it smells nice, and my face feels so soft! I can tell a huge difference in my skin when I'm using it daily (I use it once a day as part of my night routine) vs when I had to go without it for a bit when I ran out. This is definitely a must have for my routine now!

This is a product for normal to dry skin. I have used and recommended this product for years. I use it twice a week, in the morning. A gentle polish that removes the build up of dead skin. Follow with your favorite facial cleanser. This is an exfoliator, not a cleanser. For maximum results, Always use a toner after face wash.

avis.titre: Great item.  Use in the morning to start morning routine.
avis.texte: Great for early morning scrubbing of face. Part of my daily morning routine.
minimize the appearance of fine, dry lines, great and easy to use, and it also smell freshly
Feels satisfactory towards skin and has a great texture. The only problem I would say this has is that it's grainy and feels scratchy on your face.

I used a sample size of this product two days in a row and two days later my skin is flaking off like I got a chemical peel. My skin was burning yesterday and when I woke up this morning I am peeling so bad. Not sure if it had a weird reaction with my vitamin c serum or what but I won't be using it again.

avis.titre: A product that exfoliates extremely well.
avis.texte: I felt this product in the store and rubbed some of the cleanser in between my fingers and the physical exfoliatation felt a little underwhelming at first. However (a BIG however) I bought it anyway to try at home and it FELT AMAZING while cleansing and exfoliating my face. I am glad I took a chance on this product. The exfoliatation is very thorough feeling on my skin. I will be buying this again and from now on will be a part of my skin care routine!

I have been using it for many years. The particles are very small and not irritating at all. After washing, they are not greasy or dry, and there is no tightness. The face is still smooth when touched

It is a very good product to get your skin tone.I have been using for more than 3 years. i changed to other products in the between but ending up coming back to this products and decided not to change any more.
I like its texture, thick and creamy. It works for my sensitive skin but cannot use frequently.

avis.titre: Waste of your money, feels like Crisco
avis.texte: I liked the old formula so much better with the menthol or whatever, (but they removed the ingredient that made your face tingle because ONE person complained) and I really felt like it did a great job exfoliating. This cream has almost no granules, so I don't understand how women can say it's great for exfoliation. The word "polishes" should not be in the description. It is SO hard to rinse off too. I feel like I have smeared Crisco on my face. I will never buy this again.

used to love this, for years. It had the perfect balance of exfoliation and moisture. now there is little to no exfoliation and its very heavy and greasy. why do companies insist on fixing something that isn't broken? this is a completely useless product now. using it up on my hands, way to heavy for the face.

I wish I would have read the most recent reviews before I purchased this product. There rips little to no exfoliating. If I don't was with another cleanser after using this I end up with pimples. I NEVER have pimples. I d not recommend.
I love how my skin feels after I wash with this scrub. It is gentle enough to use every day which keeps my skin looking young and smooth.
I have used this for over 30 years, off and on. I still go back to it when I find that my skin needs some tlc. Especially good this time of year when my skin is flaky and dry. Will continue to use❤️
Great product. Thick, creamy and makes me feel really really clean. Works well for my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I always come back to this scrub
avis.texte: I've tried many physical exfoliants, but this one makes a difference I can actually see. I have sensitive, combination, acne-prone skin and use a chemical exfoliant daily (not Clarifying Lotion) and 7 Day Scrub Cream once a week. I like that I can adjust the intensity of the 7 Day by virtue of how much product I use -- a generous amount provides more cushion as well as effective exfoliation. It's a mainstay.
This has coconut oil which is can cause breakouts. Got cystic acne after using this product

avis.titre: Subtle and gentle but works so well!
avis.texte: My skin is so dry and flaky. I also have rosacea so it's also sensitive. I bought this to help exfoliate and brighten my skin and it has done just that, in less than a week! And it has not irritated my rosacea at all. In fact, it looks better than it has for a while. I got the sample size and will definitely be buying the full size soon! The exfoliant is so subtle but does its job perfectly. I have paired this with the Moisture Surge Intense face cream and my face is so soft.

I use this once or twice a week and have been for years. After recently running out and not using for a few weeks, I noticed my skin just didn't feel as fresh. Replenished my supply and started using again and that renewed, fresh, clean feeling is back! One of Clinique's best products in my opinion.
I do like this product. It works well and is gentle on the skin.

It's a popular product, but I like it very much. This water-soluble formula is easy to clean after use, and the sanding particles are also the smallest and most gentle ones I have used. I have used this product for several years.
Clinique 7 day scrub is just what I need. Love the texture and feel.

I ordered this by mistake, I was trying to order the exfoliating scrub, this stuff is horrible, I've used it twice a day for 3 days and still have flaky skin! There's also no cool refreshing feeling, just a warm greasy feeling afterwards, NEVER AGAIN, waste of my hard earned money!

I used to love this product. It was the perfect amount of exfoliation - not too little and not too much. However, the formula changed several years ago and there's almost no exfoliation. Very disappointed. I don't recommend if you want the feeling of smooth, exfoliated skin.

I have used this for years. I only buy the 7 day scrub. The other one Clinique has is to hard on skin in my option. It's creamy and it rids my dead skin off. At 78 years old I need a good scrum. I use this scrub in the morning and my makeup goes on nice. It's a rinse off and I just use a washcloth not real wet and likely remove it with warm water. Then use your toner. For me I shave my face and after rinsing it off I apply my shaving cream and it makes shaving better. Then toner 1.0 Clinique no Alcohol. Then all Clinique products
Soo amazing only used it for a few days and my skin feels amazing and has cleared up!

If you have thick skin like me, skip this one. Get the Men's face scrub instead. It has the grit you are missing! Just like the discontinued scrubs of the past, the men's scrub has the bite you need for strong exfoliation. This is for much more delicate skin.
This cleanser removes makeup and leaves your skin feeling clean. It doesn't dry your skin and is gentle enough for everyday use even though it is a scrub. I love it!
I got this product in the mini size (30 ml), and I like it! It removes my excess oil and leaves my skin feeling so soft!

I absolutely love this scrub. It is gentle enough to use on my dry skin , yet it is very effective. It provides the right amount of exfoliation before I apply my favorite Clinique cream or moisturizer

I've tried numerous scrubs labeled "for sensitive skin", and all of them just irritated mine even more. I have sensitive skin and rosacea. This scrub doesn't irritate either. I know sensitive skin should use chemical exfoliants (per the experts), but I just can't bring myself to do that. I knew if I kept searching that I'd find a non-chemical one that would work, and this is it. I use it maybe once every two weeks when I want a clean slate. I will buy this for as long as they make it!
I have super sensitive red cheeks. This product is too scrubby and irritates my skin. May be good for other people but not me.
I would recommend this product.My Face skin is totally different now!!!!

It's been a few years since I purchased this product and was not aware it had changed. The cleanser is way heavy on the cream and little to no exfoliate. After using, I don't feel like my face is cleansed or exfoliated and I feel like I need to wash my face again. I don't wear much makeup, but this cream is so think I can't imagine just "wiping it away."
Nice product but a bit too creamy with just enough grit. Gentle. Exfoliates my lips as well.

This product made my skin break out ! I looked like I had big mosquito bites all over my face. I lost count after 7. I am 64 yo and have used Clinique for years. I have never had a reaction to any kind of face product- from any brand. And over the course of my adult life, I've used many (high end) brands. I am surprised and disappointed in Clinique.
This is gentle enough for my sensitive skin. Leaves my skin smooth and clean ready for the moisturizer. And A little goes a long way.
This product is wonderful I first thought it was to be used every 7 days …..then I was told every day. I love it
I used to have rough skin and when I used this, it became soft.

avis.titre: Great product. Use almost every day.
avis.texte: Use daily . I have sensitive skin and this does not irritate it.

Clinique's Pep-Start was my HG for daily, gentle exfoliation but sadly it was discontinued, so I purchased this scrub instead. Unfortunately, the tiny beads are hard, sharp, and scratchy. They don't dissolve and stick to your face even with the shower water pouring down. They also got in my eyes and under my contacts causing significant irritation. So disappointed, Clinique.
